text:
ana (sales): Quick POC sync — HeliosGrid confirmed next-week trial for our Dedicated offering. They want SSO + SCIM + RBAC + cross-domain support. Can we list constraints and pricing roughs?
kevin (solutions): Thanks. For SAML we'll need their IdP metadata URL and entityID. For SCIM: total user count + expected sync cadence (full vs delta). RBAC: map of 4 roles they need (admin, manager, app_user, read_only).
marta (security): FYI we need answers on: SAML assertions (email, sub, groups?), SAML audience & recipient checks, user provisioning auth method (OAuth bearer vs basic). Also confirm data-at-rest keys and KMS region.
linda (finance): Pricing note — for POC we can offer 2-week sandbox at 50% of reserved baseline. If they exceed sustained qps we'll quote reserved SKU. Need expected concurrent sessions and daily token estimate.
raj (HeliosGrid): We're ~28k users, daily active ~6k, SSO via Okta (will share metadata). SCIM target is nightly delta + on-demand delta. RBAC: want delegated admin per domain + per-team roles.
kevin (solutions): Good — delegated admin means SCIM group write + additional role attribute. For POC we'll create 3 test domains and 6 test users per domain. Can HeliosGrid provide a demo IdP tenant and SCIM creds?
ana (sales): I'll get the Okta metadata and SCIM creds by EOD. Can we draft a minimal test plan: 1) SAML login 2) SCIM push create/update/delete 3) role-based access check 4) failover to hosted model if Dedicated capacity hits limit.
marta (security): Add: check assertion replay protection and SCIM rate-limit behavior; need logging format for audit. Also confirm whether logs include raw SAML attributes (we redact PII by default).
linda (finance): To finalize quote, need projected monthly token count + whether they want backup region. Also ask legal about SLA add-ons for enterprise.
kevin (solutions): Test plan + quick config snippet:
```
SAML:
  entity_id: https://redwood.example/saml
  acs: https://redwood.example/saml/acs
SCIM:
  base_url: https://scim.redwood.example/helios
  auth: Bearer <token>
```
ops-bot: p-experiment-764 created for helio-poc (dedicated-sandbox). URL: https://console.redwood.internal/p/expt/764
raj (HeliosGrid): Wed 10am PST works for the kickoff. Can we also cover domain ownership proof? They require multiple MX/TXT checks across three domains.
ana (sales): Scheduled invite sent. Agenda: intro, security Qs, SCIM creds, pricing rundown, next steps. I'll attach security questionnaire (link) and ask legal for a fast-track NDA if needed :thumbsup:
kevin (solutions): I'll prepare an RBAC mapping doc and a small script to simulate 5k concurrent token requests during the POC.
marta (security): I'll review the security questionnaire and flag any enterprise blockers. Quick ones: HSM/KMS integration for customer-managed keys, audit retention window, SCIM delta consistency guarantees.
raj (HeliosGrid): Thanks — we'll aim to share metadata + sample users before EOD. Looking forward to Wed.
ana (sales): Excellent. Team — call prep checklist in the thread. Anything else? :wave:
